k-sym-CATEMAS.title: Catemas $CATEMAS Cate-paired coins
k-sym-CATEMAS.sourceSays: Posts say the deployer of $CATE launched a $CATEMAS paired with Cate; another account says an earlier $CATEMAS holder was "vamped" by it four days later.
k-sym-CATEMAS.reason: Posts of Nov 22 describe a Christmas-themed Catemas tied to the Cate coin and its deployer; most other posts are call-group entry/multiple shills, and the deployer link is an unverified claim.

k-uranus.title: Elon Musk Uranus post coins
k-uranus.sourceSays: Posts show an Elon Musk account post of Nov 21 saying "It's high time we probed Uranus again!"; a news account repeats it. Coins named Uranus launched after it.
k-uranus.reason: The Musk post (20:40 UTC Nov 21) is in the saved search, widely repeated; the URANUS pools opened roughly 5-7 hours before this run, after the post.
